symptom: A flow holding an action mxcli has no MDL for (describe prints `-- Unsupported action: <$Type>` — Microflows$SendExternalObject before ako/mxcli#1939, GenerateDocumentAction in ako/mxcli#1942, GenerateJumpToOptions/ApplyJumpToOption in WorkflowCommons) lost that activity when rebuilt from MDL: a drop + create from its describe output (the route MDL-V1-REBUILD recommends) or the whole-flow rebuild `create or modify` falls back to under mdl 0. check passed, exec printed Created.
cause: No guard: the reader keeps such an action as UnsupportedAction/UnknownAction (type name only), describe prints a comment, and every rebuild path builds the flow from the statements alone. The existing guard-don't-drop checks (checkNoQueuedCalls, checkNoUnwritableRestBody, ADR-0005) covered only a rewrite of an existing unit, never the drop + create route.
file: mdl/executor/validate_flow_verdicts.go + flow_unsupported_guard.go (FlowUnsupportedRule: a create or modify predicted as an mdl 0 rebuild of a flow holding unsupported actions is refused in the verdict pass check -p and exec's preflight share); the drop + create and exec-time rebuild guards are validate_unsupported_actions.go (35398f63, landed in parallel)
insight: Landed in parallel with 35398f63 (the same guard for drop + create and the exec-time rebuild), so this change was reduced to its delta when merged: exec's rebuild guard fires only when exec reaches the statement, after every earlier statement was written — a half-applied script — so the verdict pass refuses the predicted mdl 0 rebuild up front, as it already does a drop + create. Lesson: check main for a parallel session's fix to the same issue before opening the PR, not after the merge conflicts. The drop + create route cannot be refused at the create: by then the drop has deleted the flow, so a refusal there turns 'activity lost' into 'flow lost'. It has to be refused before the script runs — the verdict pass that check -p and exec's preflight share — which is why the exec-time guard covers only the rewrite of an existing unit. Studio Pro-authored subjects exist in ako/TestApp WorkflowCommons; ACT_Workflow_JumpTo cannot even be built from its description (the unsupported action declares $WorkflowJumpToDetails, which later statements read), so its mdl 0 verdict is 'unpredictable' — the mdl 0 test needed ACT_WorkflowJumpToDetails_Apply and an edit the splice structurally cannot make (taking a branch's return away); a crowded insert is refused under mdl 1 but spliced under mdl 0, and dropping an else branch splices under both. The splice under mdl 1 keeps unsupported activities and is the control. Proven by stubbing the verdict (both refusal tests fail) and the exec guard (exec of the mdl 0 rebuild succeeds and loses the activity); the CLI exec of the drop + create says 'Refusing to execute … Nothing was written'.
